name: Lesbians
overview: Scripture reveals God's design for human relationships as male and female, established from creation (Matthew 19:4). The Bible condemns same-sex relations as contrary to this design, labeling such acts as abominations (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13). Romans 1 further explains that God allows those who reject His truth to follow unnatural desires, including women exchanging natural relations for those against nature (Romans 1:26). These passages demonstrate the biblical stance that lesbian behavior is outside God's intended order and subject to His righteous judgment (Romans 1:18).
